audit_items.proof_trace: Property misunderstands EIP-4844. The spec defines MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK as a total constraint, not a decremental per-tx budget. Code correctly validates sum(tx.blobGas) <= MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK at block level (L336) and individual tx.blobGas <= MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK at transaction level (TxValidator.cs:L239). No 'remaining blob gas' concept exists in EIP-4844.
